### Emulator

- Repinned from `ghcr.io/lex00/floci@sha256:5ec92ae8046445d62c0009590dd09f04560886e5a5ef31248cb3fcc09b2961ec` to `ghcr.io/lex00/floci@sha256:8b0b0f332d01515a1525fc5f6d3f63265f12f67c64065a3bf9224524382d7d54`

- Fixed: `-behold` and `-chant` on `choudoufu investigate` and `choudoufu mcp` accept a `.js`, `.mjs` or `.cjs` path and run it with `node` found on PATH. Before, behold's `dist/cli.js` failed with `exec format error` and `bin/behold.js` was skipped when it was not mode-executable, so a source checkout of behold needed a wrapper script (`TestScriptEntryRunsUnderNode`).
- Changed: the AWS emulator is repinned from `ghcr.io/lex00/floci@sha256:5ec92ae8...` (tag `c688f52`) to `ghcr.io/lex00/floci@sha256:8b0b0f33...` (tag `920d475`, lex00/floci develop as of 2026-11-02), which still carries the old pin's EKS sub-resource tagging fix. `live/floci-capabilities.json` is re-probed for it. Cloud Control `ListResources` on floci now refuses a type it does not enumerate with `UnsupportedActionException` where it used to return an empty list, and `tools/floci-capability-gen` records that refusal as unimplemented. SQS queues and SSM parameters now list through Cloud Control. `aws_redshift_cluster` goes from implemented to partial: floci now starts a container per cluster, so create needs the docker socket, which this harness does not mount. The board's rows stay at their last measurement until they are re-measured.
- Fixed: when Cloud Control refuses to list a type (`UnsupportedActionException`, which real AWS answers for a type whose handler has no LIST and floci answers since `920d475`), discovery now treats the type as one Cloud Control cannot list and tries its remaining routes, instead of failing the list. A declared instance is looked up in the estate's tag index or record store, as for any type with no list route. With neither, the plan refuses with "Unlistable marker-discovered type", and the sweep records the type as not listable rather than covered. Both messages name Cloud Control's refusal. Previously the refusal was a "Failed to list a resource type" error that stopped the plan, or an incomplete-sweep warning. On floci's earlier pins the same types came back as an empty list, which planned a create for a declared instance and recorded the sweep as covered. Content-match types get the same handling. `tools/floci-capability-gen` and discovery now share one definition of a list refusal (`cloudcontrol.IsListRefusalCode`).
- Fixed, on the new runtime: check blocks and data postconditions now report what the default runtime reports (#2418). A check block's scoped data source that fails to read is the check's result, with the read's error as its message, and the check's assertions are skipped; statuses after an apply are recorded instead of staying unknown, including assertions on a data source read during the plan; a reference to a check block's scoped data source from outside the check is refused with "Reference to scoped resource"; and a postcondition that fails while planning keeps whatever refers to the resource from evaluating it, so an index into an empty data result no longer adds a second error. A failed provider read no longer adds a "Provider produced null object" error. `TestContextChecks` and `TestContext2Plan_dataSourcePreconditionPostcondition` are off the experimental lane's expected failures. The `checkrules` and `datasources` ports carry the change, behind their existing switches.

## What's Changed
* new runtime: check-block data reads and data postconditions gate as on the default runtime by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2427
* live: repin floci to lex00/floci 920d475, capabilities re-probed by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2428
* discovery: a Cloud Control list refusal falls through to the type's remaining routes by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2429
* docs: minimize AGENTS.md and drop the .claude/agents subagents by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2430
* fix(live): -behold and -chant accept a .js entry and run it with node (#2280) by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2431
* test(livegraph): terralith-gen scale 1 output decodes against chant's schema (#2285) by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2432
* live: pin floci-az 61c830e, which serves the Log Analytics workspace lists (lex00/floci-az#23) (#2433) by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2436
* ci(release): cut and publish releases with chant release by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2437
* release: cut v0.35.0 by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/choudoufu/pull/2438
